# Immutable RAKL v3 schema assurance fixture

These files are byte-exact Git blobs from `SzeChunYiu/RAKL` commit
`bd1a2768f0f474ff44ffa25243241f94bfaf6466` (tree
`b0f14dc300e20eb74a69f946e06343af1683ca16`). They are test evidence only:
they let RAKL_math reproduce the postmerge audit of PR81 while the application
submodule remains historically pinned to `15f1c3affe5bf85ba41ff0ab65b25ba19e0d28a3`.
The tests assert each fixture's Git-blob identity before using it. These files
are not an executable framework fork and grant no application authority.
